essential_support.source: official DEG experimentally determined bacterial records
essential_support.mapping: same species exact sequence first; otherwise alignment >=90% identity with >=90% coverage of each sequence and E<=1e-5

selection: union of explicit envelope or resistance keyword annotation (including ontology descendants), exact DEG sequence or same-species DEG homology support; no MIC or peptide scores, no numeric panel cap
quality_exclusions: sequence caution erroneous gene model/pseudogene when explicit

clustering.stratification: species, source proteome and three-bit evidence category signature
clustering.algorithm: MMseqs2 greedy length representative, accession-sorted input
clustering.exact_sequence_collapse: after clustering, keep all source membership metadata
clustering.scope_claim: 90% identity/90% bidirectional coverage within source proteome and evidence category, not global 90% nonredundancy

limitations: Reference strains are not verified assay isolates.
Keyword annotation is functional evidence, not evidence of AMP binding.
Essentiality transfer is condition-dependent and homology support is inferred.
No CARD-specific resistance mapping or experimental resistance confirmation is claimed.
Ranking stability and panel composition controls are subsequent validation, not completed by constructing this library.

revision.reason: Independent pre-selection semantic audit: host/target/organelle membrane is not evidence of bacterial envelope. Remove these descendants and suppress generic membrane parents when foreign-location annotations coexist unless independent bacterial envelope keyword remains.

assay_source_policy.selection: Prefer exact strain identifier match with a complete public proteome and auditable UniProtKB per-protein annotations; otherwise use the predetermined same-species annotated reference proteome and state the exact availability gap. Deduplicate reused source proteomes.
assay_source_policy.preserve_cross_source_variants: Near-identity clustering is within source proteome; only identical sequences merged across source proteomes.

source_revision.reason: Main manuscript bacterial-strains paragraph supplies six exact strain identifiers; use it to correct species-only source selection before panel results exist. No MIC or peptide score used.
